The model aims to assign an input image to one of 1000 classes. This task is challenging because the images vary widely along different attributes (columns). These include rigidity (monkey < canoe), number of instances in image (lizard < strawberry), clutter (compass <steel drum), size (candle <spiderweb), texture (screwdriver <leopard), distinctiveness of color (mug < red wine), and distinctiveness of shape (headland < bell). Adapted from Russakovsky et al. (2015).
